name: grayout
description: Your Mac goes gray until you get back to work.
author: Aarush Kandukoori

scripts.check: for f in main.js src/*.js ui/*.js ui/preload/*.js build/afterSign.js scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.pack: npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --publish never
scripts.dist: npm run helper && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --x64 --publish never

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Grayout can use your camera, only if you turn it on, to notice a phone in your hand. Frames go to the Grayout service with the screenshot, are deleted from this Mac immediately, and are never stored by the service.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Grayout takes a screenshot of each display about every 45 seconds and asks the Grayout service whether you are clearly not working. Screenshots are deleted from this Mac immediately and are never stored by the service.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Grayout does not need to control other apps. If you see this prompt, you can decline it.
